description: This file defines the ElementHandleDispatcher class which acts as an intermediary for handling element-related actions and attributes in a browser automation or web scraping context within the Playwright framework. It provides methods for element interactions, attribute access, and querying.

classes.name: ElementHandleDispatcher
classes.description: Dispatcher class that wraps ElementHandle objects and exposes an API for automation, including element interactions, attribute retrieval, and querying.

methods.name: ownerFrame
methods.description: Retrieves the owner frame of the element handle and returns a FrameDispatcher for that frame.

methods.name: contentFrame
methods.description: Returns the content frame of the element if it's an iframe or frame element.

methods.name: getAttribute
methods.description: Gets the value of the specified attribute from the element.

methods.name: inputValue
methods.description: Retrieves the current value of an input element.

methods.name: textContent
methods.description: Gets the text content of the element.

methods.name: innerText
methods.description: Gets the innerText property of the element.

methods.name: innerHTML
methods.description: Gets the inner HTML of the element.

methods.name: isChecked
methods.description: Checks if a checkbox or radio element is checked.

methods.name: isDisabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is disabled.

methods.name: isEditable
methods.description: Checks if the element is editable.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the element is enabled.

methods.name: isHidden
methods.description: Checks if the element is hidden.

methods.name: isVisible
methods.description: Checks if the element is visible.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches a DOM event on the element.

methods.name: scrollIntoViewIfNeeded
methods.description: Scrolls the element into view if it's not already in view.

methods.name: hover
methods.description: Hovers over the element.

methods.name: click
methods.description: Clicks the element.

methods.name: dblclick
methods.description: Double-clicks the element.

methods.name: tap
methods.description: Taps on the element (touch event).

methods.name: selectOption
methods.description: Selects options in a select element.

methods.name: fill
methods.description: Fills the element with the provided value.

methods.name: selectText
methods.description: Selects text within the element.

methods.name: setInputFiles
methods.description: Sets files for input[type=file] elements.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Sets focus on the element.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Types text into the element.

methods.name: press
methods.description: Simulates pressing a key on the element.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Checks a checkbox or radio element.

methods.name: uncheck
methods.description: Unchecks a checkbox or radio element.

methods.name: boundingBox
methods.description: Returns the bounding box of the element.

methods.name: screenshot
methods.description: Takes a screenshot of the element.

methods.name: querySelector
methods.description: Returns an ElementHandle for the first element matching the selector.

methods.name: querySelectorAll
methods.description: Returns an array of ElementHandles for all elements matching the selector.

methods.name: evalOnSelector
methods.description: Evaluates a script on the element matched by the selector.

methods.name: evalOnSelectorAll
methods.description: Evaluates a script on all elements matched by the selector.

methods.name: waitForElementState
methods.description: Waits for the element to reach a specific state.

methods.name: waitForSelector
methods.description: Waits for an element matching the selector to appear in the DOM.
